scope: small superficial cut or scrape with controllable bleeding
patterns: how do I clean a cut
response: For a small cut or scrape: wash your hands, rinse the area under clean running water, gently remove visible dirt, then apply firm pressure with a clean cloth if it is bleeding. Once bleeding stops, cover it with a clean bandage. Change the bandage if it gets wet or dirty and watch for signs of infection.
red_flags: bleeding will not stop with firm pressure for 10 minutes
cut is deep, gaping, or on the face
something is stuck in the wound
wound from a dirty or rusty object without recent tetanus
